verdict.rationale: Filee documents a one-line `filee convert <files> --to <format>` command. It adds script-oriented features: `--json` output and defined exit codes (0/1/2/3), which make it usable from scripts and CI. The GitHub README also has an official command-line section. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in real CI pipelines, and explicit documentation of CI or headless environment support.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented command converts a file in one line, usable from scripts and CI

citations.quote: "filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
"--json" prints the result for scripts; exit codes are 0 (nothing failed), 1 (some files failed), 2 (wrong arguments or a missing input) and 3 (nothing to convert).
